profile.headline: Software Engineer | HBCU Grad
profile.summary: As a Software/Data Engineer with a passion for helping people, I enjoy translating data into actionable insights that can be used to improve peoples' lives. While at Assurance, I worked on a cross-funtional team developing data pipelines and models, which provided critical insights that informed future growth and directions. In my spare time, I enjoy reading and trying new food.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated the Outreach DataMart from PySpark to SQL, reducing processing time by ~85%. This included updating/transforming complex sessionization logic, resulting in identifying and correcting a data consistency issue impacting ~3% of the existing records.

- Developed a pipeline to identify commonly used high complexity queries before they caused service outages, and implemented various solutions to reduce complexity. This is estimated to have reduced service outages by ~5%.

- Led the implementation of SQLFluff formatting to over 300 data models, enhancing code readability and standardizing SQL formatting across our Trino view models. This was projected to increase developer efficiency by ~10%.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Apache Airflow · Data Engineering · PySpark · SQL · Data Build Tool (DBT) · Data Pipelines · Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Bruno, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Collaborated With Data Science to design and implement a Happy Listening Experience (HLE) metric. HLE was used as a core metric in 10+ experiments (one of which increased YouTube Music Daily Active Users by ~15%).

- Implemented AVOD/SVOD Revenue Aggregation Pipeline, processing 20+ million records daily. This laid the foundation for more comprehensive analysis of YouTube Music and Premium revenue data.

- Discovered a bug where a critical internal dashboard was mis-labeling ~500k users and led the cross-functional effort to update the pipelines and logic that fed the dashboard.

- Designed and conducted an A/B experiment modifying the YT Premium Buyflow. This resulted in ~13% increase in User Reactivation within 7 Days.
positions.insights: Skills: Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Data Pipelines · TensorFlow · C++ · System Monitoring · A/B Testing

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
-Integrated Emoji Analysis into an existing NLP framework, enhancing text sentiment analysis on ~40% of processed text data. Then enabled more nuanced understanding of the user's moods, which improved the apps behavioral recommendations.

- Optimized data processing for GPS and Mobile Sensing data, by identifying and filtering out noise, which improved home identification and sleep cycle accuracy by ~12%.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Environment · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Startup Development · Jira · R (Programming Language) · Quality Assurance Analysis

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description: As an intern at Google, I worked with a group of interns to develop a WebApp that displays a daily "Good Deed" for users. I directed and desgined the server-side of the application. This meant creating the data scheme, implementing the database, and creating testing for server to client communication. I also managed data access for various roles.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Integration Testing · JavaScript · Database Design · Back-End Web Development
